en.name: Yuzu, fresh fruit
en.summary: Fresh yuzu keeps 5–7 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped in plastic. For anything left over, freeze the juice and the zest rather than the whole fruit — stored that way they keep indefinitely.
en.pantry: No room-temperature timeline is published for fresh yuzu. It is a thin-skinned, highly aromatic citrus that dries out and goes soft quickly in a warm kitchen, and the fruit is expensive and seasonal enough that a few days on the counter is a real loss. If you are using it the same day, a bowl on the worktop is fine; otherwise wrap it and refrigerate it straight away.
en.fridge: 5–7 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped in plastic in the crisper. The wrapping matters: yuzu skin is thin and knobbly and loses moisture fast, and an unwrapped fruit shrivels within days. It is also powerfully aromatic, so wrapping keeps that perfume off everything else in the drawer. Check for soft spots where the skin has been dented, because that is where the fruit gives way first.
en.freezer: No time limit is given for frozen yuzu, and the recommended approach is to freeze the juice and the zest rather than the whole fruit. Zest the fruit first, always — the peel carries most of the aroma and is worth more than the juice — then squeeze it. Freeze the zest in a small flat packet and the juice in an ice-cube tray, then bag the cubes. Kept at −18 °C (0 °F) both will hold for long-term storage, and you get to use a seasonal fruit all year.
en.thawing: Use zest and juice straight from frozen, dropping them into a sauce, a dressing or a drink. Thaw larger quantities in the fridge rather than at room temperature.
spoilage: Soft, sunken patches on the skin, usually where the fruit was bruised.
Blue or green mould, which spreads through a bag of citrus quickly.
A skin that has gone dry and leathery and no longer releases oil when scratched.
A fermented or musty smell instead of the sharp floral yuzu perfume.
tips: Zest before juicing — the peel is the best part of the fruit.
Freeze juice in ice-cube trays and zest in flat packets.
Wrap each fruit; unwrapped yuzu shrivels and scents the whole drawer.
Buy in season and freeze what you cannot use, rather than paying for it out of season.

faq.q: How long does fresh yuzu keep?
faq.a: 5–7 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped in plastic.
Freeze the juice and the zest rather than the whole fruit. No time limit is given for them, so it is a good way to keep a seasonal fruit all year.

faq.q: Should yuzu be kept at room temperature?
faq.a: No timeline is published for it. The skin is thin and it dries out quickly, so wrap it and refrigerate it unless you are using it the same day.

zh.name: 新鮮香橙（柚子）
zh.summary: 新鮮香橙用保鮮膜包好，放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 5～7 天。用不完的部分，請把汁和皮屑分別冷凍，而不是整顆冰起來——這樣保存可以放很久。
zh.pantry: 新鮮香橙沒有公布的室溫期限。它是皮薄、香氣極強的柑橘，在溫暖的廚房裡很快就會失水、變軟；而且它價格不低、產季又短，在檯面上放個幾天就是實實在在的損失。當天就要用的話，放在碗裡沒問題；否則請立刻包好冷藏。
zh.fridge: 用保鮮膜包好、放蔬果室，4 °C 以下 5～7 天。包起來這件事很重要：香橙的皮薄又凹凸不平，失水很快，沒包的果實幾天內就會皺縮。它的香氣也極強，包好可以避免整個抽屜都染上那股味道。請留意皮上被撞到的軟點，果實通常就是從那裡開始壞的。
zh.freezer: 冷凍沒有給時間上限，而建議的做法是把汁和皮屑分開冷凍，而不是整顆凍起來。永遠先刨皮再榨汁——香氣大半在皮上，皮的價值比汁還高。皮屑用小袋壓平冷凍，果汁用製冰盒凍成塊再裝袋。保持在 −18 °C，兩者都可以長期保存，讓你一整年都用得到這個季節限定的水果。
zh.thawing: 皮屑和果汁直接從冷凍取用，丟進醬汁、沙拉醬或飲料裡即可。量大時請放冷藏解凍，不要放在室溫。
spoilage: 皮上出現軟塌凹陷的斑塊，通常是被撞過的地方。
長出藍綠色的霉，在一袋柑橘裡擴散得很快。
外皮乾成革狀，刮一下也不再滲出精油。
聞起來有發酵味或霉味，而不是那股銳利的花香。
tips: 先刨皮再榨汁——皮才是這顆果實最好的部分。
果汁用製冰盒凍，皮屑壓平分小袋冷凍。
每顆都包起來；沒包的會皺縮，還會把整個抽屜染上味道。
產季買、用不完就冷凍，比在淡季花大錢買划算。

faq.a: 用保鮮膜包好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 5～7 天。
請冷凍果汁和皮屑，而不是整顆。它們沒有給時間上限，是把季節水果留一整年的好方法。
它沒有公布常溫的期限。皮薄、失水快，所以除非當天就用，否則請包好冷藏。
